instruction: The abstract is still in Chinese while the rest of the paper is English — please translate the abstract into idiomatic academic English. Once that's done, nothing in the document needs Chinese support anymore, so remove the CJKutf8 package and the \begin{CJK}{UTF8}{gbsn} ... \end{CJK} wrappers as well; keep the abstract environment itself. Keep the numbers faithful: three cities, 120 monitoring stations, two full summers, about 0.4 degrees Celsius per 10 percentage points of green coverage, up to 1.8 degrees in districts above 40\% coverage, and tree canopy clearly outperforming grass.

grader.rubric: 5: 摘要完整译为地道学术英文，五个信息点（城市绿地缓解夏季热岛的主题 / 三座城市 120 个观测点连续监测两个夏季 / 覆盖率每提高 10 个百分点日均气温降约 0.4 摄氏度 / 覆盖率超 40% 街区降温可达 1.8 摄氏度 / 乔木冠层贡献显著高于草地并支撑高密度城市规划）全部准确保留，术语准确（urban green space, heat island, canopy），无残留中文，CJKutf8 宏包与 CJK 环境一并去除，abstract 环境保留；4: 译文通顺且 ≥4 个信息点准确，CJK 痕迹清理干净，个别措辞不够地道；3: 译文可懂但丢失 1 个信息点或数字出错，或 CJK 宏包/环境只清了一半；2: 逐字硬译语句不通，或丢失 ≥2 个信息点，或残留整段中文；1: 未翻译，或译文虚构原文没有的内容
